statement: Pinned Linux packages an output rumble report with report ID, incrementing packet counter and eight rumble bytes; source frequency/amplitude lookup encodes separate motors and provides evdev FF_RUMBLE via kernel memless callback when compiled.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Output bytes and host FF mapping are consumer code; high-definition actuator waveform response and retail force/intensity fidelity unverified.
